unallocatedBackingLedgerEstimate.meaning: Source-defined shared rebuildCapacity ledger estimate, with unallocated backing in the pinned B3_TREE_HEURISTIC=0; these bytes participate in core ledger, not actual leafBoxes/binIndices backing allocation.

separateAccounting.doNotAddOrEquate: World ledger and module allocator are different, partly overlapping accounting scopes; world/global bridge rows are not additive to each other. The 780-byte difference between net module and ledger changes is not assigned to one category by this report.

limits.noHistoricalBackfill: This SDK227 capture does not precisely attribute or replace failed SDK225/226 runs, including the missing two SDK226 diagnostic payloads. Their original FAIL statuses remain.
limits.sameWorldIdentity: Observer checks the same backend object and production factory; stable worldId/generation corroborate, but numeric IDs alone do not establish module identity. Mutation revision is not an allocation epoch.
limits.afterAppClose: UNAVAILABLE; no getter, module access, replacement factory or second module
limits.preMountCleanup: NOT_QUALIFIED for unattached/unowned objects from pre-mount construction failures; this normal mounted path does not widen that claim.
limits.qualifiedInterface: getNativeCounts/getNativeMemoryDiagnostics are real backend diagnostics, not the stable IPhysicsWorld interface.
limits.noFutureResults: No new reclamation implementation, second capture, browser qualification, or full100cycle pass is claimed.
